description: This Java class 'ByConditionFinder' provides mechanisms to create entity conditions based on XML configurations for query filtering, including handling 'where' and 'having' clauses using various Condition subclasses.

classes.name: ByConditionFinder
classes.description: A specialized ListFinder that constructs entity conditions ('where' and 'having') from XML configuration elements, enabling dynamic filtering in entity queries.

methods.name: getWhereEntityCondition
methods.description: Constructs and returns the 'where' clause condition for an entity query based on the provided context, model, and field types.

methods.name: getHavingEntityCondition
methods.description: Constructs and returns the 'having' clause condition for an entity query based on the provided context, model, and field types.
